decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for a single-storey rear extension to the rear of the dwellinghouse, because of the position, design and appearance of the extension, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristcs of No.34 Central Avenue and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwellinghouse or the character of the locality. The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the Council's Adopted Unitary Develoment Plan (December 2003) and is compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the sotheast and northwest walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Informative: The applicant is advised that the proposed roof extension must be substantially completed prior to commencement of the single-storey rear extension hereby approved, or any other extensions, otherwise it will no longer be lawful.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
